mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 44 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park under clear skies. We also have a lovely First Quarter moon tonight. If you are an early riser, the International Space Station will be visible for two minutes starting at 4:57 AM. It will rise over Mount Horeb and travel toward Fitchburg and Madison, passing almost directly overhead.

The City of Verona is offering new Stormwater Utility Credits for residents who participate in pollution reduction. You can apply by using rain gardens or barrels on your property. Also, the police department is currently reviewing information regarding a bus that may have hit a traffic sign during a recent O W I arrest.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Hop Haus Trivia is happening today, followed by Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's tomorrow. Later this week, look out for live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee on October 23.

On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. Fortunately, no injuries were reported, and the investigation is ongoing.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for our flavor of the day, Devil's Food Cake. The store opens today at 10:00 AM.
